findings.title: An archived recording audio backup still has no visible opening control
findings.observed: The ordinary Feishu catalog entry is repaired. Its transcript can be read while audio backup fails; retry succeeds and displays one archived audio backup. The audio result row and expanded saved-items/checkpoint disclosure still provide no audio detail or original opening control. Only transcript links are available in the exercised flow.
findings.correction: Give the actual archived audio item a named opening/download path with its source, original availability and processing state; verify it from the ordinary catalog flow.

findings.title: Calendar task notices leak into other action pages
findings.observed: After refreshing revoked review-device authorization, the device-refresh notice appears on a separate suggestion review. After verifying an uncertain calendar event, the same-event verification notice appears on the ordinary todo page. The underlying state transitions remain sound, but the message is detached from its owning task.
findings.correction: Scope transient action notices to their originating task and clear them when navigating to a different action workspace.

findings.title: Selected-file retention copy still says selected directory
findings.observed: Mac and Android selected-file tasks explicitly restrict authorization to named files and exclude the containing directory. Their retention explanation still says the original files in the selected directory are retained, including in the confirmation. This is a minor wording inconsistency on an otherwise working selected-file flow.
findings.correction: Use selected-file wording on this task while keeping directory wording on folder collection.

findings.title: The named R32 status defects have current regression evidence
findings.observed: Google Calendar now reports a saved range and archived results without the obsolete no-scope/pre-sync message. MCP repeats report new 0 / duplicate 1 for that attempt. Mac capture stop now displays a stopped/paused notice while preserving sending pause. The Feishu ordinary recording entry includes independent authorization and source acknowledgment. DingTalk completion was not independently credited in this focused round.
findings.correction: Preserve these observed transitions while repairing the remaining audio and task-notice defects.

findings.title: Fixed calendar review binds real choices and recovers the original event
findings.observed: Custom all-day dates, timezone, location, notes and target calendar survive fixed review. A changed evidence version withdraws old approval and keeps the edited draft. After new approval, a lost receipt is resolved by verifying the same synthetic event and operation IDs. Ordinary no-due todos complete and reopen separately.
findings.correction: Keep the precise fixed-review and existing-event recovery pattern; other action kinds and native shared variants remain explicitly untested.

findings.title: Scoped maintenance has meaningful file, operation and retained-evidence behavior
findings.observed: A downloaded portable3 fixture is rejected after changing its account; the correct file resumes the same partially completed operation after browser reload and re-selection. Index publication stops on failed authorization recheck. A seven-day diagnostic export truthfully contains only October 22 retained events with partial coverage. Turning off detailed trace capture preserves old traces; an unknown run shows no trace.
findings.correction: Preserve the scoped results and original-operation recovery. Cancellation/paging variants and untouched encryption, decryption, retention, statistics and export families remain untested.

findings.title: Native selected files, receipts and mobile hierarchy improve without proving completeness
findings.observed: Mac selects two independent files, confirms a local-only task and blocks unconnected sending. Android selects one file and holds it pending context acknowledgment. Dirty drafts remain on Continue editing. Mac receipt date filters obey both endpoints, and actual-content navigation returns to the same receipt. Fresh three-platform primary pages render without horizontal overflow; mobile Library removes its repeated title. Full 188-feature completeness remains unverified.
findings.correction: Retain these focused transitions and the simpler mobile title; do not convert route availability or untested variants into feature passes.

harness_notes: The first portable-import reload used the helper reset=1 URL and reset the synthetic account by design. It is not product-loss evidence. The authoritative refresh/retry journey is maintenance-reload with no reset query.

MCP label whitespace, hidden duplicate desktop labels and route changes caused selector timeouts. Corrected visible selectors and later saved states establish the evidence; timeouts are not scored as product failures.

Android uses one-file radio selection, unlike Mac multi-file checkboxes. The initially replayed checkbox commands failed; subsequent visible radio selection and confirmation are authoritative. The retention option was reselected visibly before scored confirmation.
A stale calendar approval button was absent as expected after evidence changed; attempting its former label timed out. The saved stale state and new review establish the guard.

The next-index-submit failure fixture did not produce an unknown receipt when retrying an existing operation; that branch is untested. Filename 17-index-unknown is historical and the report follows its actual waiting-state DOM.
Asynchronous file reading caused a snapshot with the prior account-rejection notice before the correct-file state settled; settled selection and original-operation evidence are used for outcomes.
The DingTalk selector hit a collapsed catalog disclosure and timed out; no DingTalk workflow completion is credited.
